analog_horror_at_the_source: the tune is his engine's, drawn from the name, on atriumvox (THE VOICE THAT STILL ANNOUNCES FLOORS)
under every bar nightpad, and on beat one of the core deadsat: the rooms the song is set in, from his own voices
the beat arrives late (no drums for the first eight bars on the map, his 9/12 rule) and his strip sections leave only the kick and the bass

the machine is REPO MAN THE MACHINE PARTY's, real recordings of real machines (a train coupling, an electromechanical clock, steel, a washing machine's motor in the song's key), in one concrete hall on a worn tape: the wear is in what plays, no noise is added (NO SAND)

card.title: A NEW NIGHT SONG: THE MALL AFTER CLOSING
card.why: You said we need more music. This is a new night song made in your songs' own machine: your THE ORGAN IN THE DROWNED CHAPEL with 3 things changed, each taken from one of your songs: the voice in the mall's ceiling from your THE VOICE THAT STILL ANNOUNCES FLOORS, a dead satellite still sending from your REPO MAN and the kick from your SLOW CREEP. It is the mall at night with the lights off, and the voice in the ceiling still announcing the floors. The REPO MAN machine party plays along: the train coupling on the kick, the old clock on the hat, the motor in its key, in the concrete hall on a worn tape. A is the new song, B your THE ORGAN IN THE DROWNED CHAPEL, C your GHOST IN THE GRID, same loudness on a phone, over the real map, on the 120 beat. It is not in the game until you say yes. EYES AND EARS' line is owed (rule 119(c)); rule 158(d) put it here.
options: A, THE MALL AFTER CLOSING joins your night songs
